🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION, with breadth strong at 8/11 sectors positive. Risk-off cross-currents include SPY/TLT falling (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -4.31%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND) and HYG/LQD falling (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.64%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND), while breadth argues against a broad risk-off call.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is increasing: VXX (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.55%) ABOVE TREND; the VIX indicator is also rising (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +8.21%, ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND). Credit stress is rising as HYG/LQD falls (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.64%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND); stocks are also lagging bonds, with SPY/TLT falling (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -4.31%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Mixed: Dollar Strength is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +1.19%, → flat), while the yield-curve indicator is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +2.29%, ↑ rising). Duration preference is also ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +1.42%, ↑ rising).

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive sector ETFs are firm: XLU (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.13%) and XLP (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +8.03%) are ABOVE TREND; energy also leads with XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND. The Tech/Financials ratio is falling (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -8.41%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND), but sector breadth shows both positive; style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are softer: SPY (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND, while EEM (1W: -1.34% | 1M: -7.79%) and FXI (1W: -4.52% | 1M: -5.64%) are also BELOW TREND. Relative indicators remain weak: EM vs US is falling (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -7.42%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND), while Europe vs US is in RECOVERY (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -1.23%, → flat).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation remains mixed: IWM is in RECOVERY (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -2.10%), while ARKK is in RECOVERY (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -10.59%). Crypto is weak, with IBIT (1W: -0.41% | 1M: -3.87%) BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Energy strength contrasts with broad commodity weakness: BNO (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.80%) is ABOVE TREND, while CPER (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.91%) and GLD (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -6.40%) are BELOW TREND. Copper/Gold is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +3.21%, ↑ rising), a positive cycle signal despite the weak copper ETF trend.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy momentum is firm: XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%) and BNO (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.80%) are ABOVE TREND. Natural gas remains weak, with UNG (1W: -10.13% | 1M: -17.06%) BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%) is positive across both timeframes, as is TLT (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +2.83%). DIVERGENCE: IWM (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -2.10%) and ARKK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -10.59%) are RECOVERIES; the weak SPY/TLT ratio (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -4.31%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND) keeps risk appetite cautious.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor energy and defensive exposure: XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%), XLU (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.13%) and XLP (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +8.03%) are ABOVE TREND. Keep broad risk selective; SPY (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -0.94%) and QQQ (1W: -0.76% | 1M: -4.95%) are BELOW TREND, while style remains mixed.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If energy leadership persists, favor XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%); if defensives hold up, monitor XLU (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.13%).
BEARISH: If the Tech/Financials ratio continues falling (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -8.41%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND), watch XLK (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%) for continued weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If energy momentum extends, monitor BNO (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.80%), currently ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If metals weakness persists, watch SLV (1W: -5.42% | 1M: -15.45%) and GLD (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -6.40%), both BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor VXX at 18.7200 (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.55%, ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND), HYG/LQD at 0.7419 (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.64%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND), and SPY/TLT at 9.3431 (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -4.31%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND). XLK/XLF at 3.2778 (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -8.41%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND) is the relative-style pivot to watch.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION remains the regime, with Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, despite weakening credit and stocks-versus-bonds signals. Energy and defensive ETFs are showing relative strength, while style leadership is mixed. Monitor rising volatility and falling credit and SPY/TLT ratios for further deterioration.
